summary: Independent review of account-neutral confirmation discovery, re-reviewed from scratch at the corrected head. All four findings I raised on 76e237c9 are fixed and each has a control: (1) ENTRY ADMISSION — the un-flagged 'resting_entry' stamp is REMOVED from the Webull fan-out draft entirely, so none of the five live consumers of that key (notably the resting_entry_restart_dedup at oms/service.py:1669, which could have refused a Webull leg before submit) sees a changed value; the predicate now keys on fanout_slot, which existing Webull fills already carry, so no new stamp is required. Verified by grep that resting_entry now appears only on the three Schwab paths. (2) SILENT DEGRADE — a blank strategy_schwab_1m_v2_webull_account_name now raises ConfirmationDiscoveryConfigurationError and logs [V2-CONFIRMATION-EXIT-DISCOVERY] status=COULD_NOT_TELL reason=webull_account_not_configured at ERROR instead of quietly reverting to the Schwab-only query. (3) FLAG-FLIP INTEGRITY — the record path now falls back to a source_fill_id lookup AND backfills fanout_slot_id onto a dark-period row, healing rather than merely avoiding the source_fill_id unique collision. (4) UNDECLARED DEPENDENCY — now a fail-closed check, reason=fanout_identity_source_disabled, when neither dual_broker_fanout nor flip_owned_first_entry is enabled. Also verified the predicate still fails closed for reclaim (fanout_slot=reclaim is rejected regardless of cw_entry_slot) and that the discovery census is logged emits_on_change_only. Mutations, each independently RED against tests/unit/test_confirmation_exit.py + test_v2_dual_broker_fanout.py (68 passed baseline): Webull shape rejected by predicate -> 5 failed; drop account widening -> 4; drop missing-slot_id fail-closed -> 1; drop Schwab-representative preference -> 1; flag default flipped ON -> 4; drop webull-account config check -> 1; drop identity-source check -> 1; drop source_fill_id fallback -> 2. Controlled full unit pair vs base 4fed979: base 46 failed/3540 passed, head 46 failed/3555 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed. Ruff clean. Ancestor test PASS. Trial-merged against #944 and #946 — clean. Ships DARK: strategy_schwab_1m_v2_confirmation_account_neutral_discovery_enabled defaults False and a mutation flipping that default turns 4 controls red.
